name: Front Cleave
hint: Move out of the flashing front side.

name: Savage Strike
hint: Single target attack. Provoke can redirect it.

name: Heavy Smash
hint: Tank must survive with Guard Wall healing or support.

name: Crushing Meteor
hint: Gather on target. Cannot be provoked.

name: Brutal Cast
hint: Use Leg Sweep before it resolves.

name: Crush Armor
hint: Aims at a weaker member. Guard or heal them.

name: Cinder Drop
hint: Three fire squares burn for 2 turns.

name: Wildfire Bait
hint: Targeted square burns. Bait it away from stack paths.

name: Gravity Crush
hint: Gather on target to share the crushing hit.

name: Furnace Roar
hint: Raidwide fire. Guard Wall and Cura stabilize after.

name: Twin Beam
hint: Two wide laser lanes rotate each use.

name: Clock Tower
hint: Stand in marked tower or it explodes raidwide.

name: Overclock
hint: Interrupt the charge or prepare for heavy raidwide.

name: Overclock Beam
hint: Charged beam. Guard Wall and Cura if charge was not stopped.

name: Toxic Needle
hint: Poisons a weak ally. Esuna or heal through it.

name: Ice Prison
hint: Locks movement. Cover the prisoner or cleanse them.

name: Shatter Lock
hint: Targets imprisoned ally. Cover or Guard Wall if still bound.

name: Dragon Voice
hint: Top and bottom edges explode. Move to side-middle safe cells.
